files.description: The complete B.10 EHI Export documentation page. Contains the full text of CarePaths' export documentation: a brief description of the export mechanism (ZIP per patient, accessed via admin UI) and a list of 7 file categories included in the export (CCD XML, accounting PDF, messaging TXT, chart PDFs, audit logs, appointment history, and uploaded documents). This is the entirety of the vendor's EHI export documentation — no data dictionary, schema, or sample files exist.
Viewport screenshot of the B.10 EHI Export documentation page showing the top portion of the content — the heading, export mechanism description, and beginning of the file list.

Full-page screenshot of the B.10 EHI Export documentation page showing all content including the complete file list, footer, and site navigation. Captures the entirety of the vendor's EHI export documentation in a single image.
